messages: viv: sharing a quick UX pass on the compact trace header — main problems we keep hearing: export is visually too prominent, corr-id is easy to miss for SR users, and the header gets crowded on narrow screens. quick thoughts? nate: thanks — agree. my priority order: 1) make corr id discoverable to SR/keyboard, 2) reduce accidental exports, 3) keep quick share actions accessible on mobile. zoe: idea: replace full "Export trace" primary button with an overflow kebab for heavy actions and add a small "••" quick-actions trigger next to corr id for Copy + Permalink. keeps visual weight down. ari: +1 on kebab for export. i also want to try a small persistent optical affordance for the corr id (subtle left margin + icon) so scanning eyes find it quickly. on mobile collapse metadata under a single toggle. a11y-bot: auto-scan: current corr-id token contrast 2.9:1. mobile touch target (16px) < recommended 44px. issues: lack of focus-visible styles, no aria-live feedback for copy. nate: accessibility fixes we should include: bump pill contrast or add 1px dark border; ensure copy button has aria-label with id; add aria-live region for copy confirmations; ensure all interactive controls are 44x44 on touch. zoe: microcopy: change `Export trace` -> `Download trace (JSON)` when it triggers a file download. If we keep export in kebab, the kebab menu item can say `Download trace (JSON, full)` vs `Snapshot (small)` if we implement two sizes. ari: keyboard/focus order proposal: skip-to-timeline link (visible on focus) -> corr-id -> quick-actions -> kebab. that way screen readers hit the identifier before any actions. small DOM reorder does this. viv: prototype suggestion for SR feedback and tooltip-on-focus pattern: ``` // on click -> document.getElementById('copy-msg').textContent = 'Copied correlation id 0a1b2c.' ``` nate: also ensure tooltips use aria-describedby and appear on focus, not just hover. and add keyboard shortcut hint in the popover like "Press C to copy" if we add hotkeys. zoe: responsive note: on widths < 600px, collapse metadata line to a two-row layout with corr-id first row, actions second row (kebab + quick-actions). keeps the ID visible at top. ari: logging/telemetry: when users export, log event `ui.trace.export` with corr_id, export_type, size_bytes. naming convention for files: `trace--.json`. reduces confusion. viv: thanks team — action items I9ll file: (1) move download -> kebab, (2) add quick-actions popover next to corr-id with Copy + Permalink + Share, (3) reorder DOM so corr-id comes before actions, (4) bump pill style + add focus-visible rule, (5) implement aria-live copy feedback, (6) mobile stacking rules. will upload updated frames later today. :raised_hands:
